The designer should remove one of these duplicate dimensions.","recommended_correction":"Delete either D15 or D23 so the slot length is dimensioned only once."},{"rule_id":"MX-006","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D9","page":1,"quote":"2-⌀8.4"}],"comment":"The pattern of two ⌀8.4 holes has no position defined: there is no PCD, spacing, pitch, coordinates, hole table, or linear dimensions locating them in the drawing. Without a location the machinist cannot place the holes. The designer should add dimensions to locate this hole pattern.","recommended_correction":"Add linear dimensions, a PCD, or other positional call-outs to fully define the location of the 2-⌀8.4 holes."},{"rule_id":"MD-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D21","page":1,"quote":"20±0.02"}],"comment":"The drawing carries tight tolerances (D21 at ±0.02, D24 with an H7 fit code) but has no datum flags or GD&T frames anywhere. Without datums the inspection reference frame is undefined, making it impossible to verify these tolerances consistently. The designer should establish a datum reference frame appropriate to the part's function.","recommended_correction":"Add datum features and reference them in the tolerance call-outs or GD&T frames for the tight-tolerance dimensions."}]}
